Name: Medieval Farm Stall Retexture
Author: Ekibo3
Description:
This mod adds a [b]medieval-style retexture for the Farm Stall Lite's honesty stall [/b]with Stoel1994's permission, helping it better match medieval and rustic Stardew Valley themes. The texture was hand-drawn and follows the wood tones and carpentry style commonly used in medieval aesthetic packs.

[size=4]Requirements[/size]
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Farm Stall Lite

[size=4]Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].
[*]Install [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43703?tab=description]Farm Stall Lite[/url]﻿[/b].
[*]Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/ mods folder.
[/list][size=4]Compatibility[/size]
This mod only replaces the stall texture used by [b]Farm Stall Lite[/b] and should be compatible with most other mods.

[size=4]Credits[/size]
• [b]MichaelS/Stoel1994[/b] – creator of Farm Stall Lite
• [b]Gweniaczek[/b] – inspiration for the medieval visual style
